name: Fintech-Fraudies
description: Real-time fintech fraud detection system combining machine learning, risk analysis, and transaction monitoring in a scalable monorepo architecture.

paragraphs: Fraudies is a full-stack fraud monitoring platform. A FastAPI backend generates a labelled dataset of 21,000 card/account transactions, benchmarks five machine-learning models, serves the best one with per-prediction explanations, and exposes portfolio analytics through a documented REST API. A Next.js + Recharts dashboard presents the analytics, an alert-review queue, the model evaluation and a live what-if simulator.
There is no database and no external service: the dataset lives in CSV, the model in a joblib file, and both are created automatically on first start.
Educational portfolio project. The data is synthetic; it is not intended for production use in a regulated financial environment.
